method.sizes: Separate optimized Angular CLI AOT browser applications; sum of JS files; gzip level 9, Brotli quality 11; includes Angular, chart, scale and shared benchmark harness.
method.fixture: 720x320 line plus one dot per row, keyed points, numeric scales, axes and grid. Same current chart core for all adapters. No animations, tooltip or projection.
method.ssr: 5 warm-ups + 40 renderApplication requests per cell, alternating variant order; forced GC outside timing; includes bootstrap, data/definition creation, serialization and platform teardown.
method.browser: 5 rounds, alternating variant order; 3 warm-up + 12 timed mount/unmount cycles per round; 4 changed-data updates per cycle. Definitions prepared outside timings. ApplicationRef.tick plus forced layout. 2 warm-up + 10 scheduled updates per round without manual tick, measured through all render callbacks and one/two requestAnimationFrame boundaries. Foreground tab, 1280x800, DPR1, no throttling.
checks: Exactly one callback per chart per synchronous mount/update
Retained root and mark identity on updates
method.median: Mean of the two middle sorted values for even sample counts; p95 nearest rank.
method.limits: Local machine; frame boundaries are proxies, not GPU presentation. No hydration timing, network, initial JS parsing, browser data preparation, tooltip/outputs-listener performance, responsive resize, animation or heap-retention measurement. Canvas SSR emits unpainted shell; SVG emits visible chart.
